I'm a software engineer focused on AI enablement and modernization: moving legacy code, stacks, and workflows onto modern ones, with AI doing the heavy lifting and a person checking the work. I care most about the checking. Anyone can generate a migration; the value is in catching the wrong measurement, the missed dependency, and the claim that doesn't hold up. Below is work I can show, plus what I learned doing it.

Projects

  1. Legacy App Migration to a New Stack, Built with AI

    Migrated a legacy photo-gallery app to Angular, ASP.NET Core, Azure Cosmos DB, and Blob Storage, a stack I hadn't used before, with Claude as a working partner. I made the design decisions and verified every claim myself. Response compression alone cut CSS from 232 KB to 49 KB over the wire, and a fresh clone runs in 16 seconds with 13 commands. The README states what was and wasn't measured.

    Angular · ASP.NET Core · Azure Cosmos DB | Live Source

  2. Agentic Removal of a Deprecated Feature

    Removed a deprecated, still-live feature from a production codebase using a multi-pass agentic workflow: map dependencies, verify, escalate scope questions, then execute. The initial scope undercounted the real dependency graph, and the workflow surfaced multiple corrections instead of guessing. Result: 300+ files removed in about half a day across a stack of CI-passing pull requests.

    Agentic Workflows · CI/CD · Code Migration

  3. AI Agent Skill for Design-System Migration

    Built a custom AI agent skill, using spec-driven development, to run a design-system migration end to end per library: branch creation, automated code migration, generated verification guides, and quality gates. Per-library effort dropped from hours of manual work to near-zero, covering two dozen libraries in about three weeks.

    Spec-Driven Development · AI Agent Skills · Code Migration

  4. Asbury Park High School Hall of Fame: Redesign & Migration

    Defined the scope, three-phase delivery plan, and timeline for a full redesign, then built it: a mobile-responsive site with a member directory filterable by year, a donation page, an event page with printable invitation and advertisement forms, and past ceremony photo pages. Moved it from static HTML/CSS/JS to Next.js and MongoDB on new hosting with SSL, with ADA compliance and basic SEO covered.

    Next.js · MongoDB · ADA · SEO

  5. Unleashed Potential: Headless CMS Rebuild

    Defined the roadmap and timeline for a site redesign, then built it on a headless CMS with sections for podcasts, interviews, blog posts, and YouTube videos, so the owner could publish her own marketing content. Set the keyword and technical SEO strategy and set up analytics and search indexing. Rebuilding on free-tier hosting eliminated her $20-a-month Wix cost, leaving only an $8-a-year domain.

    Next.js · TypeScript · Contentful · SEO

  6. CubbieKit: Shipping Label Automation

    Designed the backend solution to a shipping label problem for a Shopify store and owned it as lead engineer, tracking work in Linear with twice-weekly standups. Built a Node.js server that queries Shopify through GraphQL and creates labels through Shippo, deployed it to Heroku, and tested it against the live store. Worked with customer service to automate return labels using sample orders.

    Node.js · Shopify GraphQL · Shippo · Heroku

  7. Law Firm Web Platform: Monolith to Headless

    Task: A law firm's WordPress site was bloated, its home page graded D on GTmetrix, and it went down periodically because it kept maxing out its hosting limits. Hosting was expensive too.

    Execution: Split it in two: a Next.js front end on Vercel, with WordPress on its own server as the content API. Wrote a Node.js microservice, added GitHub Actions deploys, and integrated Mailchimp and HubSpot CRM, which built a new mailing list of 40+ subscribers in the first year.

    Outcome: Home page GTmetrix grade went from D to A. Uptime reached 99%. Hosting costs dropped about 90%, which paid for new marketing integrations.

    Next.js · Node.js · Vercel · WordPress GraphQL · MySQL · GitHub Actions · Mailchimp · HubSpot

  8. Multi-Tenant Activity Logging for a Legal Tech Startup

    At Vault, built a multi-tenant logging system that gives each client real-time visibility into user activity and system events. Engineered the PHP/Laravel backend and the React frontend for a legal tech startup, working in a fast-paced Scrum/Agile environment.

    PHP · Laravel · React · Multi-Tenant

  9. Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Marketplace Platform

    At Vault, developed a multi-tenant e-commerce marketplace platform using Next.js and Python for an e-commerce startup, as part of full-stack delivery in a Scrum/Agile environment.

    Next.js · Python · Multi-Tenant · E-Commerce

  10. Headless Shopify Storefront: Web and Mobile

    At Vault, built a headless Shopify storefront for a jewelry brand, with a Next.js web app and a React Native mobile app, delivering a consistent shopping experience across web and mobile.

    Shopify · Next.js · React Native · Headless Commerce
